steps.decision: Proceed if plate failure fraction is below protocol threshold.
Apply variant filters after participant filtering; exact two-sided HWE in controls.
Mean-imputed allele-frequency standardized PCA; Welch comparisons with Bonferroni over tested axes. Candidate panel cannot rule out subtle ancestry confounding.
Cochran-Armitage additive trend with finite-sample null variance; available-case genotypes.
Additive logistic Wald tests adjusted for the phenotype-separated leading genetic principal component. Unadjusted scan is diagnostic only.
Per-allele odds ratios and Wald confidence limits from the same adjusted discovery models; descriptive, not confirmed associations.
No eligible adjusted discovery hits means replication confirmation is not estimable; zero is a candidate count, not evidence of failed biological replication.
